help: promote what this room has staged into shared storage - every unit, one provider's, or one unit of one provider - each related to the held one of its address (new, identical, extends, ahead, diverged) and written only where nothing held would be lost; the rest named and left in tmp/input. A dry run unless --apply

args.name: --provider
args.help: every staged unit of ONE provider, or with --id one of them

args.name: --id
args.help: one unit of the provider --provider names: a prefix of its address under the provider (a conversation id, a session's machine/project/id, an export's data-* name) matching exactly one; requires --provider

args.name: --all
args.help: every staged unit of every provider

args.name: --apply
args.help: write the promotable units and remove them from tmp/input - without it, what would be promoted is only reported
